sources.note: Nothing. Full phonology (consonants, vowels, morphology, vowel processes, Ch. 6 Tone pp. 68-96): three underlying tone levels L/M/H, surface super-high via upstep, downstep, phrase-final L falls; TBU = syllable. No mention of word stress, accent, or prominence anywhere in the 191 pages (text-layer a full-text search for stress/accent/prominen/penult returns only tone-diacritic and wordlist hits).
